verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a card-issuing and payments API platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from plugged-in MCP servers falls outside its product category. The evidence shows only that Marqeta publishes its own MCP server for other agents to call. That is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
